【文章标题】：SonicWall: Attackers did not exploit zero-day vulnerability to compromise Gen 7 firewalls
【文章摘要】：SonicWall Gen 7 firewalls were targeted by ransomware attacks, initially suspected to be via a zero-day vulnerability. However, the attacks were linked to CVE-2024-40766, affecting SSL VPN functionality. SonicWall advises upgrading to SonicOS 7.3, resetting passwords, and enabling protections.
